blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Find \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) and simplify where \(f(x) = 4x - 7\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ko "difference quotient" kehte hain: output mein kitni tabdeeli aayi, us ko input ki tabdeeli \(h\) se divide karna. Aage chal kar calculus (derivative) isi se shuru hota hai, is liye yeh sawal bohat ahem hai.
Diya kya hai? Seedhi line ka function \(f(x) = 4x - 7\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) ki simplest shakal.
Plan: \(f(a + h)\) aur \(f(a)\) nikalna, minus karna, phir \(h\) se divide (\(h \ne 0\)).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 4x - 7\), aur \(h \ne 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\).
Tareeqa: Rule mein pehle \(a + h\) rakhenge, phir \(a\). Dono ko minus kar ke jo terms cancel hon unhein hatayenge, phir \(h\) se divide karenge. \(h \ne 0\) is liye zaroori hai ke zero se divide karna mumkin nahi.

\(f(a + h)\) aur \(f(a)\) nikalein
\[f(a + h) = 4(a + h) - 7\]
\[= 4a + 4h - 7\]
\[f(a) = 4a - 7\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki jagah poora input rakha. Bracket ke bahar wala 4 andar ki dono cheezon (\(a\) aur \(h\)) ko multiply karta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(f(a + h)\) ko \(f(a) + h\) ya \(4a + h - 7\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Minus karein
\[f(a + h) - f(a)\]
\[= 4a + 4h - 7 - 4a + 7\]
\[= 4h\]
Kyun: \(f(a)\) ko bracket mein rakh kar minus kiya; bracket ke aage minus andar ki har term ka sign badal deta hai: \(-(4a - 7) = -4a + 7\). Ab \(4a - 4a = 0\) aur \(-7 + 7 = 0\), sirf \(4h\) bacha.

\(h\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{4h}{h} = 4\]
Kyun: Upar aur neeche dono mein \(h\) hai aur \(h\) zero nahi, is liye cancel ho gaya.

Tasdeeq
\[a = 1,\ h = 1:\; \dfrac{f(2) - f(1)}{1}\]
\[= 1 - (-3) = 4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f(2) = 8 - 7 = 1\) aur \(f(1) = 4 - 7 = -3\). Farq 4 aaya. Yeh 4 asal mein line ka slope (dhalwan) hai: seedhi line har jagah ek hi raftaar se badalti hai, is liye jawab mein \(a\) ya \(h\) nahi bacha.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) and simplify where \(f(x) = \sin x\).
blocks.explanation:
Wohi difference quotient, lekin ab function \(\sin x\) hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \sin x\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{\sin(a + h) - \sin a}{h}\) ko chhoti, saaf shakal mein likhna.
Rule kaunsa? Trigonometry ka sum-to-product formula, jo do sines ke farq ko product bana deta hai.
Plan: half-angles nikalna, formula lagana, phir \(h\) se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \sin x\), \(h \ne 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\).
Tareeqa: Upar do sines ka farq hai. Is ke liye formula
\[\sin C - \sin D\]
\[= 2\cos\tfrac{C + D}{2}\,\sin\tfrac{C - D}{2}\]
lagayenge, jahan \(C = a + h\) aur \(D = a\). Yeh formula is liye chuna ke farq (minus) aage kuch simplify nahi hota, jabke product saaf aur compact hota hai.

Quotient likhein
\[\dfrac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h} = \dfrac{\sin(a + h) - \sin a}{h}\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki jagah pehle \(a + h\), phir \(a\) rakha.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin(a + h)\) ko \(\sin a + \sin h\) nahi likh sakte. Sine bracket par "distribute" nahi hota; misaal: \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\), lekin \(\sin 45^{\circ} + \sin 45^{\circ} \approx 1.41\).

Half-angles nikalein
\[\tfrac{C + D}{2} = \tfrac{2a + h}{2} = a + \tfrac{h}{2}\]
\[\tfrac{C - D}{2} = \tfrac{h}{2}\]
Kyun: Formula ko yahi do angles chahiye. \((a + h) + a = 2a + h\), aadha \(a + \frac{h}{2}\). Aur \((a + h) - a = h\), aadha \(\frac{h}{2}\). Alag alag nikalne se formula mein ghalti ka chance kam ho jata hai.

Formula lagayein
\[\sin(a + h) - \sin a\]
\[= 2\cos\left(a + \tfrac{h}{2}\right)\sin\tfrac{h}{2}\]
Kyun: Half-angles formula mein rakh diye. Ab farq ek product ban gaya, jo is sawal ki "simplest form" hai.

\(h\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{2}{h}\cos\left(a + \tfrac{h}{2}\right)\sin\left(\tfrac{h}{2}\right)\]
Kyun: Poore product ko \(h\) se divide kiya; \(2\) aur \(h\) ko mila kar aage \(\frac{2}{h}\) likh diya, kyunke \(\frac{2 \times (\ldots)}{h} = \frac{2}{h} \times (\ldots)\). Yahi shakal answer key mein bhi hai.

Tasdeeq: \(a = 0\) rakh kar
\[\dfrac{2}{h}\cos\tfrac{h}{2}\sin\tfrac{h}{2} = \dfrac{\sin h}{h}\]
Kyun: Formula \(2\sin\theta\cos\theta = \sin 2\theta\) se \(2\sin\frac{h}{2}\cos\frac{h}{2} = \sin h\). Seedha bhi \(\frac{\sin h - \sin 0}{h} = \frac{\sin h}{h}\) aata hai. Dono barabar, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) and simplify where \(f(x) = x^3 + x^2 - 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab cubic polynomial (power 3 wala) ka difference quotient hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = x^3 + x^2 - 1\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) simplify kar ke.
Plan: \((a + h)^3\) aur \((a + h)^2\) expand karna, \(f(a)\) minus karna, har term ko \(h\) se divide karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^3 + x^2 - 1\), \(h \ne 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\).
Tareeqa: Do formulas kaam aayenge: \((a + h)^3 = a^3 + 3a^2h + 3ah^2 + h^3\) aur \((a + h)^2 = a^2 + 2ah + h^2\). In ke baad zyada tar terms cancel ho jayengi.

\(f(a + h)\) nikalein
\[f(a + h) = (a + h)^3 + (a + h)^2 - 1\]
\[= a^3 + 3a^2h + 3ah^2 + h^3\]
\[\quad + a^2 + 2ah + h^2 - 1\]
Kyun: \(x\) ki jagah \(a + h\) rakha aur dono brackets formulas se khol diye. Brackets ke aage plus hai, is liye koi sign nahi badla.

\(f(a) = a^3 + a^2 - 1\) minus karein
\[f(a + h) - f(a)\]
\[= 3a^2h + 3ah^2 + h^3 + 2ah + h^2\]
Kyun: \(a^3\), \(a^2\) aur \(-1\) dono mein hain, minus karne se cancel ho gaye. Ghor karein: jo terms bachi hain un sab mein \(h\) hai. Yeh hamesha hota hai, aur yahi agla qadam mumkin banata hai.

Har term ko \(h\) se divide karein
\[= 3a^2 + 3ah + h^2 + 2a + h\]
Kyun: \(\frac{3a^2h}{h} = 3a^2\), \(\frac{3ah^2}{h} = 3ah\), \(\frac{h^3}{h} = h^2\), \(\frac{2ah}{h} = 2a\), \(\frac{h^2}{h} = h\). Har term mein kam az kam ek \(h\) tha, is liye har term alag se divide ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: Sirf pehli term ko divide kar ke baqi bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq: \(a = 1,\ h = 1\)
\[f(2) - f(1) = 11 - 1 = 10\]
\[3 + 3 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(f(2) = 8 + 4 - 1 = 11\) aur \(f(1) = 1 + 1 - 1 = 1\); farq 10, aur \(h = 1\) se divide kar ke bhi 10. Hamara formula bhi 10 deta hai. Answer key mein yahi terms doosri tarteeb mein likhi hain; jama mein tarteeb se farq nahi parta.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h} = 3a^2 + 3ah + h^2 + 2a + h\) (key mein yahi terms \(h^2 + 3ah + h + 3a^2 + 2a\) ki tarteeb mein hain)

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Find \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\) and simplify where \(f(x) = \tan x\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab \(\tan x\) ka difference quotient.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = \tan x\).
Find kya karna hai? \(\frac{\tan(a + h) - \tan a}{h}\) ko ek saaf fraction banana.
Rule kaunsa? \(\tan = \frac{\sin}{\cos}\), aur \(\sin(A - B)\) ka expansion.
Plan: tan ko sin/cos mein badalna, common denominator, upar \(\sin(A - B)\) pehchanna, phir \(h\) se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = \tan x\), \(h \ne 0\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}\).
Tareeqa: \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\) likhenge, aur identity
\[\sin A\cos B - \cos A\sin B\]
\[= \sin(A - B)\]
istemal karenge. Sin aur cos ki identities zyada hain, is liye tan ko unhi mein badalna samajhdari hai.

Tan ko sin/cos mein likhein
\[\tan(a + h) - \tan a\]
\[= \dfrac{\sin(a + h)}{\cos(a + h)} - \dfrac{\sin a}{\cos a}\]
Kyun: Har tan ko us ke sin aur cos ke ratio se badal diya. Ab do fractions ka farq hai.

Ek fraction banayein
\[= \dfrac{\sin(a + h)\cos a - \cos(a + h)\sin a}{\cos a\cos(a + h)}\]
Kyun: Do fractions minus karne ke liye common denominator chahiye, jo dono denominators ka product \(\cos a\cos(a + h)\) hai. Pehle fraction ko \(\cos a\) se aur doosre ko \(\cos(a + h)\) se upar neeche multiply kiya.

Upar wala hissa pehchanein
\[\text{Top} = \sin\big((a + h) - a\big) = \sin h\]
Kyun: Upar bilkul \(\sin A\cos B - \cos A\sin B\) ka pattern hai, jahan \(A = a + h\) aur \(B = a\). Yeh \(\sin(A - B)\) hai, aur \(A - B = h\). Lambi expression ek chhoti term ban gayi; yahi is sawal ki chaabi hai.

\(h\) se divide karein
\[\dfrac{\sin h}{h\cos a\cos(a + h)}\]
Kyun: Fraction ko \(h\) se divide karna, denominator ko \(h\) se multiply karne jaisa hai.
Dhyan dein: Answer key mein "sinh" chhapa hai; is ka matlab \(\sin h\) (yani \(h\) ka sine) hai, koi naya function "sinh" nahi.

Tasdeeq: \(a = 0\) rakh kar
\[\dfrac{\sin h}{h \cdot 1 \cdot \cos h} = \dfrac{\tan h}{h}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 0 = 1\), aur \(\frac{\sin h}{\cos h} = \tan h\). Seedha bhi \(\frac{\tan h - \tan 0}{h} = \frac{\tan h}{h}\) aata hai. Dono milte hain, jawab sahi hai.
